shortBio: Postdoctoral Research Fellow at NUS working on zero-knowledge proofs, post-quantum cryptography, elliptic curve cryptography, and hardware-software co-design.
bio: I am currently a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the National University of Singapore (NUS), working with Prof. Jiaheng Zhang. I received my Ph.D. in 2025 under the supervision of Prof. Çetin Kaya Koç at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics (NUAA), China, where I also obtained my B.Sc. in 2020. My research primarily focuses on cryptographic engineering, zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP), post-quantum cryptography (PQC), elliptic curve cryptography (ECC), and hardware-software co-design across modern CPUs (AVX-512, RVV, NEON), GPUs, and custom hardware accelerators.
